description: Interprets typed wires and boxes as tensor and sequential composition, using graphical coherence and the interchange law. Distinguishes symmetric and braided crossings, explicit copying and discarding, and cups, caps and feedback that require additional duality or trace structure; checks interchange via Kronecker products.
